title: cuRPQ: A High-Performance GPU-Based Framework for Processing Regular and Conjunctive Regular Path Queries
gpu_scope: GPU framework for regular and conjunctive regular path queries; plain reachability is the special case of a Kleene-star query with no intermediate label constraints.
notes: Very recently accepted (SIGMOD 2026); no public code repository was located as of this pass, plausibly not yet released.
